rationale: Retain one Mosaic Forest Management platform. BCI remains the in-scope infrastructure owner at a directly reported 56.1%, PSP remains a legal co-owner through its Natural Resources mandate rather than PSP Infrastructure, and AIMCo is preserved as a former platform participant whose exact exit date is not publicly disclosed. The manager-level platform includes Mosaic LP and its general partner; TimberWest and Island Timberlands remain underlying managed affiliates.

companyFieldUpdates.description: Mosaic Forest Management is a Canadian timberlands and land-management platform overseeing the TimberWest and Island Timberlands interests across Vancouver Island and coastal British Columbia. The business manages sustainable forestry, timber production and related land uses, including renewable-energy, watershed, recreation, real-estate and carbon initiatives. Mosaic launched on November 1, 2018. BCI remains the in-scope infrastructure owner through its Infrastructure & Renewable Resources program and reported a 56.1% interest in Mosaic LP at year-end 2025. PSP Investments remains the other legal owner through its Natural Resources mandate; its exact published percentage is not publicly disclosed, and it is not treated as a PSP Infrastructure holding. AIMCo participated at launch but was no longer named in Mosaic's 2024 statutory ownership report, so it is preserved as a former owner with an undisclosed exit date.
